subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff — readiness, calendar, MAP
body:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procure@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood onboarding kickoff — request and availability

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the intro earlier. Were ready to kick off vendor setup with Redwood for the integration project (Acme Health / Redwood - POC -> production). Can we schedule a ~45 minute kickoff next week to align on onboarding steps, PO process, and the Mutual Action Plan (MAP)?

What we need from Redwood up front:
- A checklist of required onboarding docs (W-9, vendor form, security questionnaire)
- PO flow and billing terms (we usually do Net30; let us know exceptions)
- Initial MAP with milestones and owners (sample works fine)

Availability: Tue/Wed mornings EST are best for our procurement and engineering.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
procure@acmehealth.com

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding kickoff — request and availability

Hi Olivia 7 thanks — well get this moving. Proposed slots (45 minutes):
- Tue 2027-06-22 10:00-10:45am EST
- Tue 2027-06-22 2:00-2:45pm EST
- Wed 2027-06-23 9:30-10:15am EST

What I will bring to the call (and upload ahead):
- Redwood Onboarding Form (vendor intake) \u2014 please complete and return
- Vendor PO Template we use for finance/PO flow (xlsx)
- Our W-9 and standard billing terms summary
- Security questionnaire (short/initial)

Quick MAP sketch (we will share a link before the call):
1) Kickoff & doc handoff (this call) \u2014 owners: Acme procurement (Olivia), Redwood procurement (Laura)
2) Vendor intake validation + security review \u2014 owner: Redwood Security (Monica)
3) PO issuance & account provisioning \u2014 owner: Acme finance & Redwood billing
4) Test traffic & production sign-off (sample inference run) \u2014 owner: Acme eng / Redwood CS

Success criteria we typically use:
- PO issued and signed within 7 business days of final statement of work
- Security questionnaire reviewed within 5 business days or we flag follow-ups
- Test inference run with sample dataset within 14 calendar days

Ive attached the initial onboarding form and the security questionnaire to this thread for your review. Laura will cover PO specifics on the call. Sean from sales is looped in for contract/credits questions.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships (on vendor onboarding)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.docx, Redwood_Onboarding_Form.pdf

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@acmehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding kickoff 7 PO details and documentation

Olivia / team,

Quick notes on PO and finance to prep for the call:
- We accept a standard PO referencing Redwood Inference LLC. Required fields: PO number, billing address (Redwood HQ), contact for remittance.
- Typical invoice cadence: monthly in arrears per usage + any one-time setup fees.
- If Acme needs Net30, we can accommodate; net-terms go into the SOW/PO.

I attached a sample PO template (Vendor_PO_Template.xlsx) and our W-9 (W-9_Redwood.pdf). Please confirm the billing contact for Acme and any internal PO number policies we should know about.

Agenda proposal for kickoff (45 min):
1) Introductions & roles (5 min)
2) Required paperwork and owners (10 min)
3) PO flow, invoicing, billing contacts (10 min)
4) Security review & timeline for evidence (10 min)
5) MAP milestones, testing plan, next steps (10 min)

If there are specific procurement forms Acme requires (vendor enrollment portal / custom fields), please share before the call so we can confirm time-to-complete.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Vendor_PO_Template.xlsx, W-9_Redwood.pdf

---
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding kickoff 7 security and implementation owners

Hi all,

Adding a quick security/implementation checklist so we can set expectations on evidence and timing:
- Initial security questionnaire (attached) \u2014 aim to complete within 5 business days
- SOC2/ISO evidence: we can provide summary and point-in-time reports; let us know if you need copies via secure transfer
- Data handling & retention: default retention policies and options for customer-managed keys (discuss on call)
- Test plan: 1-hour sample inference test, using a sanitized dataset, executed by Redwood CS and Acme eng

Proposed timeline (rough):
- Day 0: Kickoff & docs exchanged
- Day 3: Security questionnaire returned / clarifications
- Day 7: PO issued by Acme (target)
- Day 10-14: Provisioning & test inference run
- Day 14-21: Production cutover window (subject to PO and provisioning)

Acceptance / success criteria (for MAP):
- PO received and acknowledged by Redwood finance
- Security clarifications closed (<= 5 business days)
- Successful test inference run with agreed SLA metrics observed

Thanks, happy to walk through on the kickoff.

Monica Patel
Security & Compliance (Vendor onboarding)
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.docx

---
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procure@acmehealth.com, Aaron Levin <aaron.levin@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 13:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding kickoff 7 readiness, calendar, MAP

Thanks everyone 7 Tue 2027-06-22 10:00am EST works for our team. Please send a calendar invite.

A couple of items from our side:
- Our finance contact (for PO): procure@acmehealth.com (Aaron Levin)
- We will aim to issue PO Net30; if Redwood needs shorter terms for the first month please call that out on the invoice so our AP team can triage.
- We will complete the onboarding form and the security questionnaire after this call; if Redwood can pre-populate any vendor fields (tax ID, billing contact) that will speed our intake.

Looking forward to the kickoff — can Redwood include the MAP link and the PO template in the invite?

Best,
Olivia Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
procure@acmehealth.com

-- End of thread --
